errors.text_span: rechts ein Linien- und Säulendiagramm mit separaten Komponenten
errors.evidence: The right panel is not a line chart with separate components; it is a stacked bar chart with a black line overlay, analogous to the left panel but showing net investment values.

errors.text_span: Beide Diagramme teilen sich dieselben Achsen
errors.evidence: The two panels do not share the same axes; they have the same scale and labels, but each subplot has its own x- and y-axes.

errors.text_span: die Jahre von 1991 bis 2023 in fünfjährigen Abständen
errors.evidence: The x-axis includes labels at 1991, 1995, 2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, and 2023, but the bars are annual and there are more frequent year positions than five-year intervals.
The left-panel total line is slightly above 3.2% at 1991, closer to about 3.2–3.3%; the stated value is an acceptable approximation but slightly specific.
The left-panel total line at 2000 is closer to about 2.4–2.5% of GDP rather than 2.3%.

errors.text_span: während die Gemeinden ab 2000 einen deutlich geringeren Anteil aufweisen
errors.evidence: In the right panel, the municipalities' green component becomes negative for several years after 2000 rather than merely having a smaller positive share.
